description: Source code for ucode-based scripting and debugging within a Wi-Fi hostapd environment, including VM creation, script execution, registry management, and debugging hooks.

methods.name: uc_wpa_printf
methods.description: Logs a message with a specified log level.

methods.name: uc_wpa_freq_info
methods.description: Provides frequency and channel information based on input parameters.

methods.name: uc_wpa_sha1
methods.description: Computes SHA1 hash of input strings.

methods.name: wpa_ucode_create_vm
methods.description: Initializes and returns a new ucode VM instance.

methods.name: wpa_ucode_run
methods.description: Loads and executes a ucode script.

methods.name: wpa_ucode_call_prepare
methods.description: Prepares a function call within the ucode VM.

methods.name: wpa_ucode_registry_add
methods.description: Adds a value to the registry.

methods.name: wpa_ucode_registry_get
methods.description: Retrieves a value from the registry by index.

methods.name: wpa_ucode_registry_remove
methods.description: Removes a value from the registry by index.

methods.name: wpa_ucode_call
methods.description: Executes a function call in the ucode VM.

methods.name: wpa_ucode_free_vm
methods.description: Frees resources associated with the ucode VM.

methods.name: wpa_wpa_udebug_set
methods.description: Enables or disables udebug logging and configuration.
